detected_collisions.context: The belief that the human form is an obsolete vessel to be discarded vs. the body as a sacred, integrated part of the human person.
Digital immortality via silicon vs. bodily resurrection.
Chemical optimization of the brain for performance.

newman_resolutions.context_shift: The Gnostic desire to escape the flesh cannot be synthesized with the Incarnational reality that God took on flesh.

Pius XII's parameters on plastic surgery apply here: optimizing God-given faculties (using peptides/nootropics for cognitive health) is lawful provided it is used to perfect the human form, not fundamentally rewrite or subjugate human nature.
